# log-shipper-lite

> Tail log files, parse and batch lines, and ship them over HTTP with retries, backpressure and checkpoints so restarts lose nothing Go module `github.com/Trysac/u922-log-shipper-lite`, package `logshipperlite`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
